description: Probe hidden optical routes, patch colored lamps, and keep inertial mirrors feeding several independently moving receivers. In live mode, waiting preserves the state; START and each committed trim action advance one fixed transition.
name: Rayglass Vault V2 · Difficulty 5 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Probe the opaque cabinet ports: H is absorbed, R returns to entry, paired numbers identify an exit. Patch each colored lamp to a port that reaches its numbered receiver. Start the optical run and steer every mirror so its beam remains inside the moving receiver. Charge leaks quickly when light misses; a full red heat bar ends the attempt. All receivers must be fully charged together to unlock the seal key. Waiting preserves stored charge and receiver position; START and each committed trim action advance one fixed transition. Insert the whole seal key inside AMBER's moving opening; a miss ends the attempt. Routing probes before START are safe. There is no in-game stop, reset or retry. Click a lamp socket, then a cabinet port; click each trim rail to set its target. When charged, click the seal key, then click inside AMBER's opening. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any other implementation or hidden-state access.
